title: Verifying the Outputs of PDE Solvers: From Finite Elements to Neural Surrogates
abstract: arXiv:2611.31211v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physics simulation outputs increasingly come from solvers that no expert inspects, such as third-party packages in automated pipelines, programs written by large language models (LLMs), and learned surrogates. In earlier work on cardiac pulsed field ablation, we proposed that solvers return a certificate with their answers. The certificate consists of an admissible potential and an exactly charge-conserving current, and a small independent checker turns it into guaranteed error bounds against a written specification of the physics. Here, the same checker verifies the outputs of other solvers on the same problem. Specifically, FEniCSx computes both fields and receives the same bounds as our own solver. Five plausible bugs in a correct solver, one of them about 0.2% from the true impedance, all converge and pass a grid convergence study, yet the certificate rejects or refutes all five. translated_title: 验证偏微分方程求解器的输出：从有限元到神经代理模型
translated_abstract: 物理仿真输出越来越多地来自没有专家审查的求解器，例如自动化流水线中的第三方软件包、由大型语言模型（LLM）编写的程序，以及学习得到的代理模型。在早先关于心脏脉冲电场消融的工作中，我们提出求解器在给出答案的同时返回一个证书。该证书由一个可容许的电位和一个严格电荷守恒的电流组成，一个小型独立检查器将其转化为相对于书面物理规范的保证误差界。在本文中，同一个检查器验证了其他求解器在同一问题上的输出。具体而言，FEniCSx计算两个场并获得与我们自己求解器相同的误差界。一个正确求解器中的五个看似合理的缺陷——其中一个距离真实阻抗仅约0.2%——全部收敛并通过网格收敛性研究，然而证书却拒绝或驳倒了全部五个。在三个由LLM编写的求解器中，一个是正确的……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于证书的独立验证方法（由可容许电位与严格电荷守恒电流构成），能够对包括FEniCSx有限元求解器、含隐蔽缺陷的求解器以及LLM编写的求解器在内的多种PDE求解器输出给出保证误差界，可靠地识别出那些能通过传统网格收敛性测试却实际有误的求解器。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a certificate-based independent verification method (consisting of an admissible potential and an exactly charge-conserving current) that provides guaranteed error bounds for outputs of diverse PDE solvers—including FEniCSx, subtly buggy solvers, and LLM-written programs—reliably rejecting flawed solvers that pass conventional grid convergence studies.
